Officer's narrative
Officers were dispatched to a sideswipe collision on a multi-lane roadway in Pasadena, Texas. Upon arrival, Driver 1
stated that while changing lanes, the vehicle was contacted along the right rear quarter panel by Driver 2's vehicle,
which had been traveling in the adjacent lane. Driver 2 confirmed this account and acknowledged the lane change
was not signaled. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle at the time and was
present at the scene, and both officers and independent witnesses confirmed the Passenger's presence in the
vehicle. Two witnesses in a nearby vehicle stated they saw the contact occur and described it consistently with the
drivers' statements. Photographs taken at the scene show scraping and deformation along the right rear quarter
panel of Driver 1's vehicle and damage to the left front area of Driver 2's vehicle, which is generally consistent with
the reported impact. No prior damage to either vehicle was observed or reported. Driver 1 reported pain in the left
wrist and was transported for evaluation. It is not yet clear whether the wrist injury resulted from this collision, and the
medical records will need to be reviewed. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle.
